outcome: concordance between EFW and birth weight
cohort: Parturients who delivered between 37 and 41 weeks gestational age.
finding: The study observed poor concordance between estimated fetal weight (EFW) and birth weight, but EFW was a strong predictor for identifying macrosomia, and an ultrasound performed 7 days before delivery independently predicted adverse perinatal outcomes.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at the time of delivery for parturients between 37 and 41 weeks gestation.
